subject: sox alternative function sox_alt is now improved and modernized

messages.author: 4fd3755295617742
messages.subject: sox alternative function sox_alt is now improved and modernized
parts:
All,

The R CRAN package seewave function 'sox' does not work anymore (on Windows).

1. Inside the function "sox", the  hard coded windows path is no longer the latest version.
2. "sox" now has a widows installer. Spaces in the path2exe e.g. "Program Files"  causes an error.
3. On windows, an input of the path2exe  using backslashes(/) instead of slashes(\\) causes an error.
4. With the function sox, the examples of playing a wave file will no longer work, because the method has changed
(so the examples need to be fixed.)

For my own personal use, I rewrote sox as sox_alt
Here is the code (if anyone is interested.)

License is the same as  the R package seewave
License: GPL (>= 2)

The examples use a file that is attached.( "file590414e02032.wav" )
(The language is Spanish es-MX: words; Show the back translation window. )

Note: I added an extra "argus" arguments parameter.  This seems 'not immediately useful' but I did it anyways.
Also, the 'path and executable file' are now 'shell quoted.'

sox_alt <- function (command, exename = NULL, path2exe = NULL, argus = NULL, shQuote_type = NULL)
{

    if (is.null(exename)) {
      exename <- "sox"
    } else {
      exename = exename
    }
    
    if (is.null(path2exe)) {
      exe <- exename
    } else {
      path2exe <- normalizePath(path = path2exe, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
      exe <- paste(path2exe, exename, sep = "/")
    }
      
    if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") {
    
        if(is.null(shQuote_type)) {
          shQuote_type = "cmd"
        } else {
          shQuote_type = "cmd2"
        }

    } else {  # .Platform$OS.type == "unix" # + Apple OS X + other
    
        if(is.null(shQuote_type)) {
          shQuote_type = "sh"
        } else {
          shQuote_type = "csh"
        }
        
     }
    
    exe <- shQuote(exe, type = shQuote_type)
    system(paste(exe, command, argus, sep = " "), ignore.stderr = TRUE)
    
}

# now does not assume to know the exact PATH ( because many versions exist including the latest )
# to play a .wav file sox/play now needs "-t waveaudio"
# write the path2exe using spaces
sox_alt(command = "file590414e02032.wav", path2exe = "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\sox-14-4-2" , argus = "-t waveaudio")

# write the path2exe using backslashes(/)
sox_alt(command = "file590414e02032.wav", path2exe = "C:/Program Files (x86)/sox-14-4-2"   , argus = "-t waveaudio")

# if sox, soxi, and play are in the %PATH%/$PATH . . . 
# on Windows soxi.exe and play.exe are physical coplies of sox.exe 
sox_alt(command = "file590414e02032.wav", argus = "-t waveaudio")
sox_alt(command = "file590414e02032.wav", exename = "play", argus = "-t waveaudio")
sox_alt(command = "file590414e02032.wav", argus = "-t waveaudio")

# get information
sox_alt(command = "file590414e02032.wav", exename = "soxi")
# Input File     : 'file590414e02032.wav'
# Channels       : 1
# Sample Rate    : 16000
# Precision      : 16-bit
# Duration       : 00:00:03.31 = 52960 samples ~ 248.25 CDDA sectors
# File Size      : 106k
# Bit Rate       : 256k
# Sample Encoding: 16-bit Signed Integer PCM

# old way still works
sox_alt("file590414e02032.wav slowfile590414e02032.wav tempo 0.5")

# old way: play a wave file or execute without using the "argus" parameter
sox_alt(command = "slowfile590414e02032.wav -t waveaudio")
